reviews.body: Thanks, this is the right fix in the right place. A few small comments inline

review_comments.body:
About #1883: in every layer the pane draws pane primitives before the series (`_drawSourceGroup` in `pane-widget.ts`). That's what keeps the text watermark under the series. So a pane primitive left on the default `'normal'` still draws under the series after this PR; `zOrder: 'top'` is what puts it in front. If the reporter's primitive doesn't set a `zOrder`, this won't change what they see, so I'll point them to `'top'` when the issue closes.

Could you add this to "Key differences from series primitives" in `website/docs/plugins/pane-primitives.md`, and change "three differences" to "four"? Something like:

```md
- Within each `zOrder` layer, pane primitives are drawn before the series and their primitives, so a pane primitive on `'normal'` sits under the series. Use `'top'` to draw it above the series.
```

comments.body:
Thanks for the review. Pushed 726dcda: added the layering note to "Key differences" (now "four differences") in `pane-primitives.md`, and renamed the base `paneViews()` to `allPaneViews()` with a single return type, so `paneViews()` means the normal layer for pane primitives; `series.ts` extractor updated. `tsc` and eslint are clean and the unit tests that ran before still pass.
This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
